candidates.title: Final Girls Berlin Film Fest - Best of 2026 Shorts
candidates.description: Final Girls Berlin Film Festival showcases horror cinema that’s directed, written, or produced by women and non-binary filmmakers. They are committed to creating space for female voices and visions, whether monstrous, heroic or some messy combination of the two, in the horror genre. We all have seen more than enough representations of women as beautified victims and constructions of male fantasies or anxieties, and are working towards the primacy of women as subjects and storytellers in horror. This year, you'll be able to feast your eyes on the absurd and off-kilter selection of cursed films…

candidates.title: 🔋 Beginner Soldering: Li-Ion Battery Pack
candidates.venue: Iffy Books, 404 S. 20th St., Philadelphia, 19146, United States
candidates.description:
Make a rechargeable battery pack for your LoRa node, a microcontroller such as an ESP32 or Pi Pico, or anything that runs on 3–4 Volts. Perfect for folks who’ve never soldered before! 
To complete this project you’ll need to buy a li-ion battery pack kit for $3.99. Here’s what it includes: 
• 18650 battery clip w/ attached wires
• TP4056 charge controller board
• PH2.5 plug w/ attached wires
• 1/8″ heat shrink tubing (1.5″ long)
• 1/2″ heat shrink tubing (1″ long) 
You’ll also need a lithium-ion 18650 battery, available separately.
